The values stated were determined in accordance with the prescribed WLTP (Worldwide Harmonised Light-Duty Vehicles Test Procedure) measurement method. The fuel consumption and CO₂ emissions of a car depend not only on the efficient utilisation of fuel by the car, but also on driving style and other non-technical factors. CO₂ is the main greenhouse gas responsible for global warming.
